title: 从agency转型做产品，年入近百万美元

title_ar: من وكالة إلى منتج، ما يقرب من مليون دولار سنويا

", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他曾经在阿拉斯加拉雪橇，现在教全世界做在线课程", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你绝对想不到这个创始人以前是干嘛的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Chris Badgett。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在阿拉斯加拉雪橇。管理一个冰川上的雪橇犬旅游项目，只能坐直升机上去。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他做了LifterLMS，WordPress上最流行的学习管理系统。年入96万美元，完全 bootstrapped。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "离开阿拉斯加后，Chris进入了有机园艺和永续农业领域。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做在线课程，教别人怎么种菜。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "同时也做agency，帮客户建网站。后来专门做学习管理系统(LMS)。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当时WordPress上没有一个好的LMS解决方案。所以他自己做了——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "LifterLMS。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "完全 bootstrapped。2014年发布，一直稳增长到现在。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "为什么从agency转型做产品？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Chris说有三个原因："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "想要地理位置自由和可扩展的收入。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "想通过教育帮助别人成长。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "agency客户需要LMS。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以agency自己掏钱 bootstrap 了这个产品。转型期间最大的挑战是什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "销量低的时候怎么活。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "解决方案？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "同时跑agency和产品。创始人自己也降薪。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一个版本花了60天，让一个agency的开发专注做这个。基于WordPress，用PHP、JavaScript、React，集成REST API、MySQL。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "怎么验证需求的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "预售。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做了个landing page，给早鸟优惠价，定了个发布日期。通过内容营销和社交媒体导流。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一周卖掉42份。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这给足了信心和启动资金。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在的商业模式是免费增值。核心插件免费且功能强大。30%的用户购买付费计划，解锁电商、高级测验、社交学习、分组学习等功能。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们在免费核心软件上，已经卖了600万美元的付费扩展。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Chris说：产品会自己销售自己。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "营销怎么做的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "内容营销是核心资产。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们有博客、LMScast播客（500+期）、YouTube频道（1000+视频）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最重要的内容是什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "免费快速入门课程。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "教用户怎么用软件最核心的5%功能来实现目标。过程中自然提到付费工具。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这既是营销资产，又是客户成功资产，还是onboarding工具。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Chris说：每个软件公司都应该有这个，除了文档和帮助中心。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果重来，他会更早更重注内容营销，更慢招聘团队。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有个关键因素——生态系统。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "WordPress powering 43%的网站。在这个 growing ecosystem 里做最好的免费增值解决方案，增长会 compound。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Chris的建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "MVP尽快上线。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "他们预售验证，给了动力和方向。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "创始人要做个人品牌。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "人们喜欢和真实的人做生意。信任是竞争中的关键因素。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "别把支持当成本中心。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "把支持当产品功能来做。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "LifterLMS的故事告诉我们——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从自己真实的需求出发，做出来的产品往往最靠谱。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Chris不是凭空想个点子。他自己做在线课程，自己帮客户做LMS，深知这个市场的痛点。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后一步步从agency转型，bootstrap做大。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没有融资，没有疯狂增长，就是稳步推进。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有时候慢就是快，稳就是赢。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: Transitioning from agency to product nearly one million dollars annual income. He used to sled dog in Alaska now teaches the world how to make online courses. You would never guess what this founder used to do. Chris Badgett. Sled dog in Alaska. Managing sled dog tourism project on glacier can only be accessed by helicopter. Now. He made LifterLMS most popular learning management system on WordPress. Annual income nine hundred sixty thousand dollars completely bootstrapped. One. After leaving Alaska Chris entered organic gardening and permaculture field. Made online courses teaching others how to grow vegetables. Also did agency building websites for clients. Later specialized in learning management system LMS. At that time there was no good LMS solution on WordPress. So he made it himself LifterLMS. Completely bootstrapped. Twenty fourteen released steady growth until now. Two. Why transition from agency to product. Chris said three reasons. Wanted geographic freedom and scalable revenue. Wanted to help others grow through education. Agency clients needed LMS. So agency bootstrapped this product themselves. Biggest challenge during transition. How to survive with low sales. Solution.
